faq.q: Is Candy Crush safe for kids?
faq.a: Yes. Candy Crush Saga is rated Everyone and has no chat with strangers. It sells gold bars, boosters and extra moves, so turn on Google Play's purchase authentication for children.

faq.q: Can I play Candy Crush offline?
faq.a: Yes, you can play levels you've unlocked without internet. Events, syncing progress and some features need a connection, so connect regularly.

faq.q: Candy Crush vs Candy Crush Soda: what's the difference?
faq.a: Both are King match-3 games. Soda Saga adds soda bottles, bubbles and new candy types, while Candy Crush Saga is the original with the most levels.

faq.q: How do I get more lives in Candy Crush?
faq.a: Lives refill over time, one every 30 minutes up to five. Friends can send lives, and events sometimes give unlimited lives for a short time.
